notes: Draft configuration: The course follows the named, one-way raceway from existing start-area node 2537296479 through Kennel bend and the upper Esses. The previous selection incorrectly travelled east on service way 1066055853 and returned west on a nearly coincident raceway, adding 77.7 m of duplicated approach. The geolocated start photograph (Geograph 8009693, looking west) and pinned raceway direction support removing that out-and-back; no coordinates are fitted to a target length. The corrected source route measures 939.4 m. The operator specifies a 1,000-yard (914.4 m) timed course, whereas the legacy catalogue scalar is 1163 m. The sparse final raceway segment ends 38.5 m beyond the supplied finish along the same road, with under 2 m perpendicular displacement. The existing 40 m endpoint allowance is retained; the source extent remains provisional and is not an exact timed-run distance. No interpolated finish vertex is added. All retained coordinates are exact pinned OpenStreetMap nodes. Boundaries and timing extent require review.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 56 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. This standing-start run begins at the first paired edge station and ends at the last; original timing metadata are retained. Finish speed is unconstrained, with no stopping zone modelled. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
